slides.head: Write down everything you remember.
slides.body: Book shut. No notes. Just you and a blank page.

slides.head: Check it against your notes.
slides.body: Mark what you got, and what you missed.

slides.head: Go back to the gaps.
slides.body: This is the bit most people skip.

rows.text: You write it all down, then it shows you the gaps.
Open it tomorrow, and it tells you what to do next.
